comment: murmur Pro configuration. The public key verifies license signatures offline in the app; it is public by nature. The private signing key lives ONLY on the founder's machine, never in this repo. buyUrl is the Stripe Payment Link shown in settings; empty hides the buy button. price is the one-time price in US dollars, shown on the Get Pro button and on the site, so the two never disagree. founders is the founders window (LB, 2026-10-24): through closes, every checkout link on the site and the app's Get Pro buttons carry the code, so its $10 off is already applied (US-172); after it, the plain Payment Link.
